items: Pani - Washing aur Soaking ke lie
Tomato - 2 medium size, mixi me chala kar use karein

steps.text: Chole ko do baar paani se dhoyen aur meetha soda (1/4 tsp) walay paani mein 6 ghante ke liye bhigo kar rakhen.
Suji 1/2 cup ko ek bartan mein le kar 1 cup paani daal kar 5 minutes tak rakhen taki suji phool jaye.
Maida 2 cup ko bartan mein dal kar beech mein kuaan banaen aur namak 2 tsp, cheeni 2 tsp aur baking soda/meetha soda 1/2 tsp dal kar mix karein.
Suji ke extra paani ko nikal kar haathon se halkasa nichod kar maide mein milaen.
Thoda dahi (1-2 tsp) daal kar dough banayein aur dough ko zaroori sukhapan dikhne tak tight rakh kar banayein.
Dough ko 7 minute tak masaj/need karen taaki usmein lchak aa jaye.
Ek tbsp oil dough mein daal kar 3-4 minute masaj karen jab tak dough achhi tarah mix ho jaye.
Dough par oil laga kar dhak kar kam se kam 6 ghante (ya kam se kam 30 minutes) tak proof/ferment karne ke liye rakh den.
Pyaaz 2 medium aur 1 tbsp anardana ko mixi mein bina paani ke pees kar paste banayein.
Ek patila mein 1.5 cups paani, sukhay amla (8-10), 2 tsp chaipatti dal kar ubalne ke liye rakh den.
Pressure cooker ko garam karen aur 2 tbsp oil dal kar garam masala (badi elaichi, dalchini), 1/2 tsp kali mirch, 1 green elaichi aur 3-4 laung tadka den.
Tadka mein pyaaz-anardana ka paste daal kar bhunen, phir namak dal kar bhunein.
Namak dalne ke baad 1/2 tsp ginger garlic paste daal kar 1 minute tak bhunen.
Do tomatoes ko mixi mein pees kar tadke mein daal kar medium-high flame par achhi tarah pakayen jab tak kachapan na chala jaye.
Pehle se bhigi hui aur chhanni se chaani gai chole ko cooker mein dal kar meetha soda (1/4 tsp) milayen aur ek aloo (chilka wala) daal dein.
Chole mein ubla hua amla-chai ka paani chhankar daalen aur total 1.5 se 2 cups pani mila kar mix karein.
Cooker ka dhakkan laga kar high flame par 5-6 sitti tak pakayen, phir flame low kar ke 10 minutes rakhen aur gas band karke pressure khud release hone den.
Pressure khulne ke baad chole ko achhi tarah mashed ya check karen aur agar zarurat ho to phir se high flame par ubalne dein taaki gravy achhi ho jaye.
Tadka ke liye ek bada pan garam karen aur adrak ke lachche aur 1 tbsp ghee (ya oil) mein 1/4 tsp ajwain ko 15-20 seconds bhunen aur is tadke ko chole par daalen.
Dough se medium size loayi banayein aur unko halkasa relax karne ke liye kam se kam 10 minutes rest karne den.
Loayi ko halka sa oil laga kar dry maida mein lapetne ki bajay seedha bel kar poori jaisa gola belen.
Deep pan mein tel achhi tarah garam karen aur high flame par bhatura daalen, jab aadha phool jaye to palat den aur dono taraf golden hone tak sek len.
Garama garam bhature ko garam chole ke saath serve karen.
